title: Jesus's return in the first photograph of the Shroud

tellings.quote: It was 1898 when the first photograph was taken of the shroud. That was the moment he returned and we saw him on the shroud.

plain: The writer Whitley Strieber, who says he has met non-human beings, tells Michels that Jesus returned in 1898, at the moment the first photograph was taken of the Shroud of Turin, the linen cloth kept in Turin that bears the faint image of a man and is revered by many as Jesus's burial cloth. "That was the moment he returned and we saw him on the shroud," he says, an idea he lays out in his own book Jesus: A New Vision; it would make the second coming something that already happened, quietly, through a camera.
